visual_briefs.title: Velocity as signed accumulated change
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show how small velocity rectangles accumulate to displacement.
visual_briefs.composition: Velocity curve with positive and negative regions, partition marks, and rectangle contributions.
visual_briefs.long_description: A velocity graph above the axis contributes positive displacement; below contributes negative displacement.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not label total distance as signed displacement.

visual_briefs.title: Three Riemann-sum choices
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Compare left, right, and midpoint rectangles for the same increasing curve.
visual_briefs.composition: Three linked panels or a selector for left, right, and midpoint samples on f(x)=x^2+1 over [0,2].
visual_briefs.interaction: Slider for rectangle count and method selector.
visual_briefs.long_description: An increasing curved graph with rectangles whose heights use left, right, or midpoint samples.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not imply midpoint is always exact or always an overestimate.

visual_briefs.title: Rectangles converging to a fixed total
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show Riemann rectangles becoming narrower while the sum stabilizes.
visual_briefs.composition: f(x)=x^2 on [0,2], adjustable n, left/midpoint selector, sum readout.
visual_briefs.long_description: A parabola with increasingly narrow rectangles and a numerical estimate approaching 8/3.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Avoid saying rectangles become area; state their summed areas converge to the integral.

visual_briefs.title: Positive and negative signed regions
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Display a curve crossing the axis with positive regions above and negative region below.
visual_briefs.composition: Piecewise or polynomial curve, shaded regions with signs and net-sum equation.
visual_briefs.long_description: A curve crosses the x-axis; areas above count positively and areas below count negatively.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not call the integral total geometric area.

visual_briefs.title: Equal-area average-height rectangle
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Compare the area under a curve with a rectangle of equal area and height f_avg.
visual_briefs.composition: Positive curve on [a,b], horizontal line at average value, equal-area rectangle.
visual_briefs.long_description: A curve and a rectangle over the same interval have equal area; rectangle height is the average value.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not confuse average function value with average rate of change.

visual_briefs.title: Moving upper bound and accumulated area
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show A(x)=int_a^x f(t)dt changing as x moves.
visual_briefs.composition: Two linked panels: integrand with moving shaded interval and accumulation graph.
visual_briefs.long_description: As x moves, the shaded signed area updates and a point traces A(x).
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve sign when the integrand is below the axis.

visual_briefs.title: Substitution as relabeling a composed differential
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Map inner expression u=g(x), differential du=g prime dx, and simplified integral.
visual_briefs.composition: Three-stage dependency diagram from original integrand to u-integral to back-substitution.
visual_briefs.long_description: A flow diagram shows an inner function and its derivative being replaced by u and du.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not teach substitution as arbitrary symbol swapping.

visual_briefs.title: Integration by parts from the product rule
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show product rule rearranged and integrated, with u and dv roles.
visual_briefs.composition: Stepwise proof diagram and a small decision cue for choosing u.
visual_briefs.long_description: The product rule is rearranged to produce integral u dv = uv - integral v du.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not present LIATE as a theorem; it is a heuristic.

visual_briefs.title: Reference triangles for trig substitution
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Connect radical forms to right triangles and substitution choices.
visual_briefs.composition: Three labeled triangles for sqrt(a^2-x^2), sqrt(a^2+x^2), sqrt(x^2-a^2).
visual_briefs.long_description: Three right triangles encode x=a sin theta, x=a tan theta, and x=a sec theta.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: State domain restrictions and the role of absolute values.

visual_briefs.title: Midpoint rectangles and trapezoids
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Compare midpoint and trapezoidal approximations against a curved graph.
visual_briefs.composition: Same integrand and partition with method selector and error readout.
visual_briefs.long_description: A smooth curve is approximated by midpoint rectangles or trapezoids.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not claim one method always overestimates.

visual_briefs.title: Tail area and convergence
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show finite truncations of an infinite-interval integral and a running total approaching a limit.
visual_briefs.composition: f(x)=1/x^2 from 1 to R with R slider and accumulated area readout.
visual_briefs.long_description: The shaded tail extends right while accumulated area approaches 1.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not portray infinity as a reachable endpoint.
